works.title: Book on Spiritual Change, Cultural Foundations, and Faith Evolution
works.description: A book synthesizing teachings on how spiritual beliefs change over time, examining negative influences of social media on spiritual practice, the importance of understanding cultural and ancestral foundations of faith traditions, and developing 'spiritual literacy' to resist rigid fundamentalism and shallow spiritual consumerism. Includes Biblical references, illustrations, and practical frameworks for authentic spiritual evolution.
works.quote: Help me write a book that discusses all these points and more. Include Biblical references and illustrations where necessary, and develop this topic in detail across multiple sections of the book.
